description: The '''sanâa''' or '''sanâa''' of Algiers ([[arabic]]: الصّنعة, ə-Ṣan'a) or simply the Andalusian, refers to the [[Andalusian classical music|Arab-Andalusian classical music]] of the school of [[Algiers]], whose tradition relates to the city of [[Córdoba, Spain|Cordoba]] in medieval [[Al-Andalus]].
